# OpenVTC Verifiable Trust Infrastructure

Status: upstream implementation. Source inspection: 2026-09-08.

Upstream VTA/VTC infrastructure provides distinct service, key, vault, policy and SDK components. AgentPrivacy integration must name the supported interface and configured service rather than infer authority from a Star or imported City Key.

Upstream implementation is credited to OpenVTC; no deployment or authenticated connection checked here.
